name: faire-mcp
description: Faire (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, end_listing, set_inventory, list_orders, mark_shippe

platform_mcp_faire_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FAIRE_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_faire_access_token.description: Faire OAuth access token for the brand (Authorization Code Grant: POST https://www.faire.com/api/external-api-oauth2/token), sent as X-FAIRE-OAUTH-ACCESS-TOKEN. Scopes: READ_BRAND, READ_PRODUCTS, WRITE_PRODUCTS, READ_ORDERS, WRITE_ORDERS, WRITE_INVENTORIES.

platform_mcp_faire_app_credentials.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FAIRE_APP_CREDENTIALS
platform_mcp_faire_app_credentials.description: Base64 of applicationId:applicationSecret from the Faire Developer Portal, sent as X-FAIRE-APP-CREDENTIALS (required together with the OAuth access token).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /brands/profile: the brand of the current session {brand_id, name, currency, locale}.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: PATCH /products/{product_id} (listing_id = the product id, p_…) with name and description. `price` and `quantity` are ignored here: prices are per variant and region (PATCH /product-prices/by-skus) and stock is set with set_inventory.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: DELETE /products/{product_id}: sets the product's lifecycle_state to DELETED so it is no longer visible on Faire.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: PATCH /product-inventory/by-skus {inventories: [{sku, on_hand_quantity}]} sets the on-hand units of one variant by its SKU (`sku` required; `listing_id` is ignored). All-or-nothing: an unknown SKU fails the request. Returns the resulting on_hand/committed/available quantities keyed by SKU.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: GET /orders?limit&cursor&updated_at_min, ascending by updated_at; pass next_cursor back as `cursor` (page numbers are not sent: Faire rate-limits offset paging). `since` = updated_at_min (ISO 8601). `status` is ignored (Faire only filters with excluded_states). state is NEW|PROCESSING|PRE_TRANSIT|IN_TRANSIT|DELIVERED|CANCELED|BACKORDERED|PENDING_RETAILER_CONFIRMATION; items, address and payout_costs are in raw.

tools.name: mark_shipped
tools.description: POST /orders/{order_id}/shipments {shipments: [{order_id, carrier, tracking_code, shipping_type: SHIP_ON_YOUR_OWN}]} adds a shipment and moves the order to PRE_TRANSIT (IN_TRANSIT once the carrier accepts it). carrier: CANADA_POST, DHL_ECOMMERCE, DHL_EXPRESS, FEDEX, PUROLATOR, UPS, USPS, POSTNL, CANPAR, INTERLINK_EXPRESS, GSO, ROYAL_MAIL, DPD, DPDUK, PARCELFORCE, AUSTRALIA_POST, EVRI, LA_POSTE (case-insensitive). The shipping cost (maker_cost) is not sent.
